corrections.reason: In Classical Ge'ez (Mark 9:18), the verb is የሐቅይ ('he gnashes', from ሐቀየ) and the noun is ስነኒሁ ('his teeth', plural construct ስነኒ- from ስን, translated by ጥርሱንም ያፋጫል on L04). Visually on the page, the final glyph of the first word is 6th-order ይ (with its right-side hook, not a top loop ዮ) and the second letter of ስነኒሁ is 1st-order ነ (two equal legs, whereas the third letter ኒ has the 3rd-order foot).
The word split across L22-L23 is በጾም ('by fasting'), matching ጾም on L24 and printed with ጸ (7th order ጾ), not ፀ (ፆ).
